scenes.heading: EXT. BOY'S STOCKING - CHRISTMAS MORNING
scenes.purpose: Introduce the splendid new Velveteen Rabbit as the best Christmas gift and show him briefly loved then forgotten amid the holiday excitement.
visual_beats: Plump Christmas stocking in bright festive light with splendid spotted rabbit wedged at top holding holly
Close details of intact velveteen coat, thread whiskers, pink sateen ears, boot-button eyes
Stocking gifts below: nuts, oranges, toy engine, chocolate almonds, clockwork mouse
Boy in flannel nightclothes loving the Rabbit for two hours
Aunts and Uncles arrive; tissue paper and parcels; Rabbit left forgotten on nursery floor

scenes.heading: INT. NURSERY - DAY
scenes.purpose: Establish the Rabbit's lonely cupboard life among snobbish toys and the Skin Horse's wise teaching about what it means to become Real.
visual_beats: Warm nursery with toy cupboard, fender, wooden floors; Rabbit dusty and ignored among superior mechanical toys
Model boat and Timothy the wooden lion putting on airs; Rabbit feeling insignificant
Skin Horse bald in patches with sparse tail lying kindly beside Rabbit near the fender
Intimate toy-level dialogue on Real love, shabbiness, and lasting Real-ness
Rabbit sighing with longing and dread as Nana's footsteps approach

scenes.heading: INT. NURSERY - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Show Nana's brisk tidying swoop that accidentally promotes the Rabbit from cupboard to the Boy's bedtime companion.
visual_beats: Nana in dark dress and white apron swooping toys into the open cupboard like a great wind
Boy in plain nightshirt unable to find his china dog at bedtime
Nana hurried, dragging Rabbit out by one ear and thrusting him into the Boy's arms

scenes.heading: INT. BOY'S BED - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Depict the Rabbit's first nights as bed companion, growing comfort in whispered games and tunnels, and the unnoticed start of loving wear.
visual_beats: Rabbit hugged tight, rolled on, pushed under pillow in the child's bed under night-light glow
Boy making tunnels under bedclothes like rabbit burrows; whispered splendid games
Rabbit snuggling under warm chin with Boy's hands clasped round him all night
Time-lapse wear: fur shabbier, tail unsewn, pink rubbed off nose from kisses while Rabbit remains happily unaware

scenes.heading: EXT. GARDEN - DAY
scenes.purpose: Show spring outdoor adventures together and the dewy night the Rabbit is left on the lawn, prompting Nana's grumbling rescue.
visual_beats: Long spring garden days: wheelbarrow rides, grass picnics, fairy huts under raspberry canes
Rabbit earth-stained from flower-bed burrows; coat showing beginning wear
Rabbit left alone on lawn long after dusk, wet with dew
Nana approaching with candle, rubbing him dry with apron corner and grumbling about fuss for a toy

scenes.heading: INT. BOY'S BED - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Climax of nursery magic: the Boy fiercely declares Bunny is Real; Rabbit's joy and new knowing expression noticed by Nana.
visual_beats: Boy sitting up in bed stretching out hands for his Bunny
Boy's passionate defense: He isn't a toy. He's REAL!
Rabbit's sawdust heart nearly bursting; wisdom and beauty entering dull boot-button eyes
Next morning Nana picking him up and remarking on the knowing expression

scenes.heading: EXT. WOOD - EVENING
scenes.purpose: First encounter with living wild rabbits who mock the toy's missing hind legs and wrong smell, leaving the Real-but-still-toy Rabbit rejected and alone.
visual_beats: June evening wood; Boy nesting Rabbit in bracken then wandering off to play brigands
Loved-worn Rabbit watching ants between velvet paws
Two furry wild rabbits emerging, changing shape, hopping on hind legs, dancing
Mockery of pincushion back and lack of hind legs; whiskers brushing ear; rejection for wrong smell
Boy's footsteps scattering wild rabbits in white-tail flash; Rabbit calling after them in vain; carried home alone

scenes.heading: INT. BOY'S BED - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Show extreme shabbiness accepted because he is Real, then the long fever vigil as the Rabbit hides under bedclothes to stay with the burning-hot Boy.
visual_beats: Very old shapeless Rabbit still beautiful only to the Boy; whiskers gone, spots faded, ear linings grey
Boy flushed and feverish, talking in sleep, body burning the Rabbit
Strange people coming and going; all-night sickroom light; Rabbit motionless under bedclothes
Patient snuggling and whispered plans of garden and raspberry thicket; fever turning; Boy sitting up with picture-books

scenes.heading: INT. NURSERY - DAY
scenes.purpose: Recovery morning on the balcony; doctor's order that the germ-laden old Bunny must be burnt and replaced before the seaside trip.
visual_beats: Bright sunny morning; wide-open windows; Boy wrapped in shawl carried onto balcony
Rabbit tangled in bedclothes with only head peeping out, listening
Talk of seaside tomorrow, disinfection, and burning of bed toys
Nana asking about old Bunny; Doctor decisively ordering it burned as scarlet-fever germs and replaced

scenes.heading: EXT. END OF THE GARDEN BEHIND THE FOWL-HOUSE - DAY
scenes.purpose: Dispose of the Rabbit into the rubbish sack at the bonfire site behind the fowl-house, deferred until morning by the busy gardener.
visual_beats: Threadbare Rabbit stuffed into sack with old picture-books and rubbish
Carried to end of garden behind fowl-house, a fine unlit bonfire place
Gardener busy with potatoes and peas; promise to burn the lot next morning

scenes.heading: INT. BOY'S BED - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Contrast the Boy's excited seaside dreams beside a splendid new plush bunny while his old Real companion is abandoned outside.
visual_beats: Boy sleeping in a different bedroom with new white plush bunny with glass eyes
Boy too excited about tomorrow's seaside to care much about the replacement toy

scenes.heading: EXT. END OF THE GARDEN BEHIND THE FOWL-HOUSE - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Rabbit's lonely night of memory and despair; real tear births the magical flower and the Nursery Magic Fairy who promises to make him Real to everyone.
visual_beats: Shivering Rabbit wriggling head from untied sack among picture-books behind fowl-house
Threadbare coat no protection; view of raspberry thicket like a remembered jungle
Montage of happy memories; despairing question of love's worth; single real tear falling to earth
Mysterious emerald-leaved golden-cup flower growing and opening
Loveliest Fairy in pearl and dew-drop dress stepping out, kissing damp nose, explaining she turns loved worn toys Real to everyone
Fairy gathering Rabbit and flying with him into the wood

scenes.heading: EXT. WOOD - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Fairy delivers the transformed Rabbit to the wild rabbits in the moonlit glade; he discovers living hind legs and joyfully joins Rabbit-land forever.
visual_beats: Moonlit wood; bracken fronds like frosted silver; wild rabbits dancing with shadows on velvet grass
Rabbits stopping in a ring to stare as Fairy presents the new playfellow for forever
Fairy's final kiss and command to run and play; Rabbit frozen by old shyness about missing legs
Nose tickle; automatic hind-toe scratch revealing real hind legs, soft shiny brown fur, twitching ears, long whiskers
Joyful leaping, sideways jumps, whirling; Fairy gone; at home as a Real Rabbit among the others

scenes.heading: EXT. WOOD - DAY
scenes.purpose: Spring reunion coda: the healthy Boy glimpses a familiar marked wild rabbit that was once his Bunny, without ever knowing the truth.
visual_beats: Warm sunny Spring wood behind the house; healthy Boy in outdoor play clothes
Two rabbits creeping from bracken to peep; one brown all over, the other with ghost spots under fur
Familiar soft nose and round black eyes; Boy's quiet recognition of resemblance to lost fever Bunny
Marked rabbit watching a moment then slipping back into bracken with companion; gentle resolving close
